purpose: Agent decisions for externally prepared speech, native speech and lip synchronization. No paid research generation was run.

conclusion.audioReferenceSupported: Documented through OpenRouter input_references, compatible BytePlus Seedance 2+ providers.
conclusion.originalAudioPreservation: No documented immutable-soundtrack guarantee in the reviewed unified API.
conclusion.exactLipSync: Prompted and quality-dependent; not verified with external WAV in this project.
conclusion.allWorldLanguages: Not documented. Native language coverage is explicitly listed; other languages need individual assessment.
conclusion.localTransport: Real Voiceovers desktop 12s PCM canary passed: duplicate import, page preview and identical local WAV hash. This is not evidence of model lip sync.

languageEvidence.access: English route returned a JavaScript shell. Official indexed alternate-locale route supplied the English native-language statement.
languageEvidence.lithuanian: Absent from this documented list; support and lip quality remain unverified, not proven impossible.
languageEvidence.coverageMeaning: A documented language is not a guarantee of pronunciation, dialect coverage, faithful cloning or word-perfect lip movement.

openrouter.roleMapping: The unified input reference has type and media URL. Role-specific semantic instructions belong in the prompt; do not invent a per-reference native role field here.
openrouter.frameMode: Use mixed references for audio. This app keeps first/last-frame mode separate; do not silently combine incompatible modes.
openrouter.urlRequirements: Provider-accessible raw media URLs without a login or custom headers; remain valid through processing. Local127.0.0.1 URLs are not model inputs.
openrouter.limitsAuthority: The generic OpenRouter schema lists more sizes/resolutions than this model; use live model-specific capabilities.

byteplusDirect.mapping: Native content array uses text/image_url/audio_url items and reference_image/reference_audio roles. This is a different request shape from OpenRouter, not a drop-in SDK payload.

higgsfield.mapping: Dedicated reference-to-video API has its own image/audio/video URL arrays and provider schema. Do not infer its supported resolution/duration from OpenRouter or a marketing page.
higgsfield.currentUseInAgentFlow: Cloud storage publication only; agent video jobs target OpenRouter explicitly.

liveOpenRouterCatalog.pricingVideoToken: 0.0000107 USD, with or without generated audio
liveOpenRouterCatalog.warning: A live catalog is capability/pricing metadata, not a successful audio-reference generation test.

promptGuideEvidence.audioMeaning: Reference guidance includes dialogue, voice/timbre, music and rhythm. Assign the intended function explicitly.
promptGuideEvidence.knownIssues: The guide discusses remaining source-language speech, wrong character/voice assignments and inaccurate target-language lip movements in translation tasks.
promptGuideEvidence.implication: Detailed prompt constraints improve direction; examples asking for precise sync are not a universal guarantee or a force-align API.
promptGuideEvidence.inference: For a prepared talking soundtrack, keep one clearly mapped speech track, exact transcript and measured length; evaluate the resulting video directly.

agentProtocol.sourcePreparation: Use the finished approved dialogue, not the enrollment sample. Check full transcript, one-speaker quality when appropriate, pauses, pronunciation and actual duration. Keep native script and original language names.
agentProtocol.audioModeDecision: Reference mode regenerates output audio; original mode adds the untouched soundtrack locally to silent non-speaking footage. Native mode invents speech. None may be substituted unnoticed.
agentProtocol.cameraInference: Keep a talking face visible at a reasonable scale, avoid occlusions and extreme motion, allow natural pauses. This is production guidance, not an API guarantee.
agentProtocol.timeline: The source WAV frame count controls edit duration. Request ceil(seconds) from the model and trim only its visual tail; no automatic stretching or speech rewrite.
agentProtocol.verification: Completed job and actual saved video first; then inspect full transcript, listening, speaker identity/voice, pause alignment, visible mouth movement, geography and continuity. ASR checks words but cannot verify lips or voice fidelity.
agentProtocol.languageQuality: Documented languages and unlisted languages both need quality review. Unlisted languages produce a warning and must be described as unverified. No all-language guarantee is claimed.
agentProtocol.strictAudioRequirement: If the output modifies words, voice or timings and exact audio is required, report failure. A dedicated externally driven lip-sync stage would need separate research/integration/verification; none is installed automatically.
agentProtocol.testBoundary: The user asked to run creative tests in a fresh session. Only unbillable technical fixtures are tested here.
